subject: Re: 🔵{Brand} & MobUpps
body:
Hi RECIPIENT_NAME,
Last note from me on the qualified-lead program I raised earlier, and the incrementality read I flagged in my follow-up. If validated lead quality and ZIP-level economics are on your roadmap this quarter, I can share the buyer and seller breakdown and a short holdout read this week. If the timing is not right, I will leave it here and step back. Either way you have the context for when {Brand} wants to revisit it.
register_notes: Stage 3 EN real_estate_proptech: references original email and the stage-2 follow-up so the cascade reads as one thread; direct close with clear easy out (release if timing wrong); no MobUpps figure; zero question marks; no sign-off, no em-dash, no 'X, not Y'; native English; Brand token only from candidates.
